world: narration_pipeline.make_pipeline_state (w_pipe), plus a second 管线乙 entity (char_pc) for the same-name family
note: D1/D5 samples. Program plan unless planSource=tampered. Texts are scripted; no model ran.

cases.title: 任务达成用结果表述
sentenceTexts: 管线甲从管线镇来到了钟楼。管线甲把铜铃挂回了钟楼。
cases.notes: N1 emits outcome+resultText from the state's task.resultText; the text repeats that result. The goal never appears.

cases.title: 缺 resultText 必须阻断
cases.notes: No resultText in the committed state -> N1 blocking diagnostic; the goal is not used as a substitute.

cases.title: 双人同目标（不同名）
sentenceTexts: 管线甲完成了任务「合力抬钟」。管线乙完成了任务「合力抬钟」。

counterTexts.text: 管线甲完成了任务「合力抬钟」。
counterTexts.why: one actor named: the second fact is uncovered

cases.notes: plan_v3 merges both facts into one group (same goal, same place). Naming both actors passes; naming one leaves the other fact uncovered. G4 is NOT triggered (different names).

cases.title: 同名两名角色
sentenceTexts: 管线乙完成了任务「合力抬钟」。管线乙完成了任务「合力抬钟」。

counterTexts.text: 管线乙完成了任务「合力抬钟」。
counterTexts.why: one mention collapses two same-name people

cases.notes: Two entities share the display name 管线乙. plan_v3 keeps them in separate groups and grants no pronoun. G4 is triggered by DATA (same display name, two entity ids) and requires one mention per actor.

cases.title: 同名角色获得代词授权（篡改计划）
sentenceTexts: 管线乙完成了任务「合力抬钟」。管线乙完成了任务「合力抬钟」。
cases.notes: A tampered plan grants a pronoun to one of two same-name entities. G5 is data-triggered and must fail, even though the text itself names both actors.

cases.title: 普通对照：单人
sentenceTexts: 管线甲从管线镇来到了钟楼。管线甲把铜铃挂回了钟楼。
cases.notes: Ordinary single-actor case: G4/G5 must NOT be triggered, so no conflict gate value is recorded.

cases.title: 判定器缺 resultText 阻断
cases.text: 管线甲完成了任务「把铜铃挂回钟楼」。
cases.notes: A judge-level row whose outcome fact has no resultText must block; the text quoting the goal is not accepted instead.
